outline: Geometric Progression: n-th term, sum, sum to infinity

modules.title: Module 1 · Arithmetic Progression
modules.html:
An AP has a common difference $d$ added each term: $a, a+d, a+2d, \ldots$

$$T_n = a + (n-1)d,\qquad S_n = \dfrac{n}{2}\bigl[2a+(n-1)d\bigr] = \dfrac{n}{2}(a+l)$$

where $l$ is the last term.

Key points

  • $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{7}{2}(20+6\cdot 4) = 154$.
  • $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{10}{2}(10+9\cdot 4) = 230$.

Worked example

Q: Find the sum of the first $7$ terms of AP with first term $10$ and common difference $4$.
A: 154

Q: Find the sum of the first $10$ terms of AP with first term $5$ and common difference $4$.
A: 230

modules.title: Module 2 · Geometric Progression
modules.html:
A GP has a common ratio $r$ multiplied each term: $a, ar, ar^2, \ldots$

$$T_n = ar^{n-1},\qquad S_n = \dfrac{a(r^n - 1)}{r-1}\ (r\ne 1)$$

Key points

  • $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{7}{2}(20+6\cdot 4) = 154$.
  • $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{10}{2}(10+9\cdot 4) = 230$.

Worked example

Q: Find the sum of the first $7$ terms of AP with first term $10$ and common difference $4$.
A: 154

Q: Find the sum of the first $10$ terms of AP with first term $5$ and common difference $4$.
A: 230

modules.title: Module 3 · Sum to Infinity
modules.html:
When $|r|<1$, the infinite sum converges:

$$S_\infty = \dfrac{a}{1-r}$$

Key points

  • $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{7}{2}(20+6\cdot 4) = 154$.
  • $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{10}{2}(10+9\cdot 4) = 230$.

Worked example

Q: Find the sum of the first $7$ terms of AP with first term $10$ and common difference $4$.
A: 154

Q: Find the sum of the first $10$ terms of AP with first term $5$ and common difference $4$.
A: 230

modules.title: Geometric Progression: n-th term, sum, sum to infinity
modules.html:
Geometric Progression: n-th term, sum, sum to infinity is a key part of Sequences and Series (SSS 3, Mathematics). Master the meaning, the main points and how it is tested in JAMB and WAEC questions on this topic.

Key points

  • An AP has a common difference $d$ added each term: $a, a+d, a+2d, \ldots$ $$T_n = a + (n-1)d,\qquad S_n = \dfrac{n}{2}\bigl[2a+(n-1)d\bigr] = \dfrac{n}{2}(a+l)$$ where $l$ is the last term.
  • Worked example Q: Find the sum of the first $7$ terms of AP with first term $10$ and common difference $4$.
  • A: 154 Q: Find the sum of the first $10$ terms of AP with first term $5$ and common difference $4$.
  • A GP has a common ratio $r$ multiplied each term: $a, ar, ar^2, \ldots$ $$T_n = ar^{n-1},\qquad S_n = \dfrac{a(r^n - 1)}{r-1}\ (r\ne 1)$$ Key points $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{7}{2}(20+6\cdot 4) = 154$.

Worked example

Q: Find the sum of the first $7$ terms of AP with first term $10$ and common difference $4$.
A: 154 — $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{7}{2}(20+6\cdot 4) = 154$.

Q: Find the sum of the first $10$ terms of AP with first term $5$ and common difference $4$.
A: 230 — $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{10}{2}(10+9\cdot 4) = 230$.

modules.title: Revision and exam focus
modules.html:
Revise the whole topic by working through its key points in order, then test yourself with the 50-question quiz for this topic. Pay attention to definitions, differences between similar terms, and questions that ask you to apply the topic rather than only recall it.

Worked examples

Q: Find the sum of the first $7$ terms of AP with first term $10$ and common difference $4$.
A: 154 — $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{7}{2}(20+6\cdot 4) = 154$.

Q: Find the sum of the first $10$ terms of AP with first term $5$ and common difference $4$.
A: 230 — $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{10}{2}(10+9\cdot 4) = 230$.

Q: Find the sum of the first $16$ terms of AP with first term $5$ and common difference $2$.
A: 320 — $S_n = \tfrac{n}{2}(2a+(n-1)d) = \tfrac{16}{2}(10+15\cdot 2) = 320$.
